store._note: Configuration exchange, not rows. A configuration set carries the registers, schemas, objects, views, flows, sources and mappings that make one way of working hold together. There is deliberately NO `installable` allowlist: a set exists to introduce schemas the instance does not have YET, so listing schemas this app already owns would refuse exactly the sets worth installing. The trust boundary for a bundle is its publisher, enforced by the engine's source allowlist and trusted-key check. ⚠️ An EMPTY `installable` means install NOTHING, not install anything — omitting the key and declaring an empty list are different things.

pages._note: ADR-114 Decision 4 / ADR-080. Declarative: openregister hosts the store plane, so this app writes NO store controller. With no registry configured the page renders the app's built-in items and makes NO network call.

ADR-112 / ADR-114 Decision 3. NOTHING here is invented and nothing is relocated: all seven pages already existed as routes with NO menu entry at all, reachable only by someone who already knew the URL. Carding them GIVES an entry point rather than moving one. Two neighbouring orphans are deliberately NOT carded, because a gate finding is a question rather than an instruction: AuditPackExport (/compliance/export) BUILDS an export, and EngagementRiskThresholds (/progress/engagement-thresholds) CONFIGURES the thresholds that produce the flags. Both are things you do, not readings, and ADR-097 keeps work in the main navigation. The report periods, report cards, conference reports and course-package import reports already have menu entries and stay there: ADR-112 forbids a report being BOTH a card and an entry, not being an entry.

config._note: An xAPI Statement is an immutable learning-experience event (actor, verb, object, result, context, timestamp, authority) — a log/technical archetype. Body leads with the statement data including the full actor/verb/object/result JSON (wide, 12-col, single column for readability) and a Related panel resolving the linked course/lesson. NO comms leaves, NO child rosters — an xAPI statement is a write-once event. Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail.

pages.title: School-year rollover
pages._note: Mapping editor for the jaarovergang (school-year-rollover): the "custom view only where a manifest page cannot render it" exception. Proposes a leerjaar-increment default mapping, runs the mandatory side-effect-free preview gate, and triggers the idempotent server-side execution (RolloverExecutionHandler) by transitioning the RolloverPlan to executing.

pages.title: Flows
pages._note: ADR-110 Decision 4: a flow is app-specific, so the authoring surface lives here rather than behind a deep link to another app's list. An ordinary index over the named `flows` source (config.entitySource) rather than the deprecated `flows` page type, reading OpenRegister's one native flow store (ADR-065), scoped to this app by config.app.

pages.title: Flow
pages._note: The shared CnFlowDetail canvas over the same single engine. Controls render in the NC app sidebar (sidebarComponent) so the canvas keeps full width; canvas and sidebar share useFlowStore. The _note claimed this before the field existed, so #/flows/new -- and every #/flows/:id -- rendered a bare canvas with no way to name, describe, trigger or step-edit the flow. Mirrors pipelinq#1490.
